definitions.ask: Should legacy_dad.md be deleted once dad.md is verified?
definitions.why: dad.md carries every fact and every inbound link, so a second copy would only drift

choices.label: Delete it; git history keeps the old bytes and no live link points at it
Drop only its notebook type, so it leaves the catalog but lingers as a stale duplicate

definitions.ask: Should the two zorg-only attachments be folded into dad.md as text?
definitions.why: Both files are small, live only in retired ~/org, and their vault links are already dead

choices.label: Inline the Krul review quote and a condensed ChatGPT pediatrician list as nested bullets
Copy both .txt files from ~/org into the vault at their old paths and keep the two links
Drop both dead links; the files stay only in retired ~/org

definitions.ask: Should the zorg last-edited dates be dropped?
definitions.why: Bob reads only [created::] on notebook notes and has no edit-date field

choices.label: Drop them; the dated log entries and git history carry the chronology
Keep each one as an [updated::YYYY-MM-DD] field after the note's created stamp
